baseline_matching.correction_equation: AFO torque = loaded-machine torque - matched empty-machine torque
baseline_matching.movement_direction_source: Match increasing_machine_angle and decreasing_machine_angle CSV rows separately.
baseline_matching.purpose: Preserves the dimensions required to pair loaded-machine and unloaded empty-machine torque-angle sweeps during later analysis.

calibration.calibration_status: provisional; calibration certificate and direction must be verified
calibration.geometry_status: provisional; verify dimensions and polynomial experimentally

cycle_definition: Cycle 0: startup to positive endpoint. Each numbered cycle: positive to negative to positive endpoint, with both sweeps settled. Final machine-zero return is excluded from analysis sweeps.

machine_zero_reference.reason: Machine zero verified for this controller session

record.physical_definition: Fixture homed to calibrated rotary zero within ±0.10 degrees; motor mapping anchored after stationary post-idle observation.

machine_zero_reference_final.reason: Machine zero verified for this controller session

record.physical_definition: Fixture homed to calibrated rotary zero within ±0.10 degrees; motor mapping anchored after stationary post-idle observation.

motion_conversion.conversion_status: legacy manual/identification conversion; normal tests use optional experimental model

experimental_model.status: experimental; rotary-anchored inverse targets, not prospective validation or continuous angle control

motor_feedback_statistics.timestamp_basis: host position-read completion; original times preserved

motor_timing_provenance.brackets: host monotonic seconds; not hardware synchronisation
motor_timing_provenance.capture_duration: transport queue wait plus IO lock wait and all requested property reads
motor_timing_provenance.limits: production 150 ms capture and 250 ms position freshness unchanged
motor_timing_provenance.position_timestamp: host completion of position remote read, not end of the multi-property bundle
motor_timing_provenance.uptime: omitted during powered monitor captures; read during idle/identity/recovery diagnostics

move_distance_definition: Nominal Move Distance (deg) stores absolute target minus validated pre-command feedback position, converted to AFO degrees.
odrive_final_configuration_error: Live diagnostic omitted during finalization to avoid blocking run outcome
plot_angle_source: Measured Fixture Angle from calibrated rotary sensor

rotary_sensor.angle_use: Calibrated fixture angle defines rotary homing/zero and plot angle; test trajectory conversion and torque geometry remain motor-based

profile.fit_method: OLS on equal-weight means of first 12 positions (36 captures); sensor-derived extensions excluded
profile.mounting_reference: Existing EAST fixture-shaft coupling at physical 90 degrees; operator confirmed unchanged 2026-10-14
profile.sign_convention: Dorsiflexion positive; plantarflexion negative; physical 90 degrees is zero

validation.basis: Operator reported independent remeasurement agreed with six negative sensor-derived estimates

connection.timestamp_basis: host arrival of Phidget change event; not hardware-synchronised
connection.timestamp_units: integer host monotonic nanoseconds plus seconds for joining

rotary_sensor.join_method: Latest delivered sample at load-cell read; age and sequence recorded; no interpolation

test_parameter_status: operator-entered commanded values; not independent physical measurements
torque_angle_source: ODrive-derived AFO angle; existing geometry calculation unchanged
